title: Shrimp and Corn Chowder
description: Serve this hearty chowder with a crusty baguette. Use fresh corn, if available.
ingredients: 24 medium shrimp, peeled and deveined (about 1 pound)
directions: Cook bacon in a large saucepan over medium heat 6 minutes or until crisp. Remove bacon from pan with a slotted spoon and coarsely chop, reserving drippings.
Thinly slice green onions; reserve 2 tablespoons dark green parts.
Add white and light green onion parts, thyme, and garlic to drippings in pan; sauté 2 minutes.
Weigh or lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup; level with a knife.
Sprinkle over onion mixture; cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in milk, stock, and bay leaf; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium, and cook 2 minutes.
Stir in salt, black pepper, red pepper, shrimp, and corn; simmer 4 minutes or until shrimp are done.
Divide soup evenly among 4 bowls; sprinkle with bacon and reserved 2 tablespoons green onions.
